ticket: Browser T03 durable workspace and DeepSeek provider
findingDetails: AiWorkspace routes every provider through pageSitePort(() => latestPage()), so a later page can receive a different target operation.
Eight providers share one repeatedly navigated guest; there are no durable task/turn/binding/intent records.
Submission uses generic page-text change and capture slices text after the last prompt occurrence, without stable user/assistant/parent/branch identity.
The ordinary BrowserPanel contains a global AiBar prototype rather than the requested task workspace; history/import/synthesis surfaces are incomplete.
